content.json:
# Application Operational Workbook

Auto-generated from resource discovery. Source: `{{sourceSubscriptions}}` — inventory `{{inventoryTimestamp}}`.

Covers App Service, Functions, Container Apps, and AKS.

---

content.query:
resources
| where type in~ ('microsoft.web/sites','microsoft.app/containerapps','microsoft.containerservice/managedclusters')
| summarize Count = count() by type, location
| order by Count desc
content.title: Application resources by type and region

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize Requests = count(), Failures = countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| extend FailureRate = round(100.0 * Failures / Requests, 2)
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: Request volume and failure rate

content.query:
AppExceptions
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| summarize ExceptionCount = count() by ProblemId, ExceptionType
| top 10 by ExceptionCount desc
content.title: Top 10 exceptions
